P:Detect repeated machine records using machine_id as the business key.
M:Track previously seen machine identifiers and mark later occurrences as duplicates.
Q:DEDUP(machine_id)
V:validated
A:The second M-001 record is a duplicate.

P:Measure data completeness after missing values are handled.
M:Compute populated cells divided by total cells.
Q:COMPLETENESS
V:validated
A:Completeness measures populated data coverage.

P:Partition machine records by region.
M:Group records using the region key while preserving each record.
Q:PARTITION BY region
V:validated
A:Records are separated into region partitions.

P:A machine pressure value is missing. Should the pipeline silently invent a value?
M:Missing data requires an explicit imputation, rejection or preservation policy.
Q:MISSING -> POLICY
V:validated
A:No. Apply an explicit missing-data policy.

P:A new vibration column is added to future records. What should a robust pipeline do?
M:Detect the schema change, validate compatibility and version the schema contract.
Q:SCHEMA CHANGE -> VALIDATE -> VERSION
V:validated
A:Detect, validate and version the schema change.
